name: Bill Demirkapi
biography: Bill is an undergraduate student and a security researcher for the Microsoft Security Response Center with an intense passion for Windows Internals. His interests include reverse engineering and vulnerability research, ranging from low-level memory corruption to systemic flaws with catastrophic consequences. He started his journey in high school and has since published his work at internationally-recognized conferences like DEF CON and Black Hat USA. In his pursuit to make the world a better place, Bill constantly looks for the next significant vulnerability, following the motto "break anything and everything".
